description: A peer heard during the idle wait, sending part of a C_PDU, keeps the soft link open: the wait runs out, finds the peer was heard in a burst begun during it, and counts again from the end of that burst; with nothing more heard, the link is then closed as idle.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ at 0. Link set-up and the first DATA C_PDU are as sis-session/idle-break, with an idle time of 90000: the soft link is established when our PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED ends at 57550 and sis.soft_link_idle/0.0.1.3 starts with 90000 (A-0011, A-0320); the peer's DATA-ONLY FSN 0 ('ping' for unbound SAP 9, discarded, A-0235) at 61000 restarts it to 151000 (A-0320), and our ACK-ONLY (RX LWE 1) goes out at 78000 after csma.vdcd_end 4000 and 12000 ms of contention, ending at 83550. At 85000 a new burst from the peer begins; at 86000 its DATA-ONLY FSN 1 (TX window LWE and UWE, C_PDU start but not end, a 11-byte segment, EOT 10) arrives: the C_PDU is not complete, so nothing reaches the SIS and the idle wait is not restarted. The burst ends at 87000 with an acknowledgement owed: csma.vdcd_end 4000, from the EOT end 86000 + 5000 = 91000 (K-0071). The burst ending records the peer as heard, with a valid header, in a burst begun at 85000 and ended at 87000 (C-0833). At 91000 csma.vdcd_end expires: LBT rule 1 and contention, the third draw of seed 0 (15) giving 45000 (K-0080). At 136000 the ACK-ONLY (RX LWE 2, all received in order, C-0776) goes out, one block, ending at 141550. At 151000 the idle wait expires. The peer was heard in a burst that began after the wait did (85000 is not before 61000), so the link is not idle: the wait counts again from the end of that burst, 87000 + 90000 = 177000, and restarts with 26000 (A-0320). At 177000 the wait expires again. The peer was last heard in the burst begun at 85000, before the wait's count began at 87000, so the link is idle: the SIS closes it with Idle Soft Link Terminated (A-0196, A-0205), sis.soft_link_max stops, and with nothing outstanding and no acknowledgement owed the link is clean, so the CAS goes straight to Step 1 (B-0317, B-0421): link_state breaking and LBT 3000 after our own transmission (K-0074). The rest of the break is as sis-session/idle-break. Fixture and addresses as sis-session/idle-break. Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
